title: Missed-Payment Late Fee Line on Ridgeline Consumer Credit Accounts — Systems Reference Card
content:
**Rule.** When the payments credited from a statement's date through its due date total less than that statement's minimum payment due, one late fee is owed for that statement period; it posts on the day after the due date, references the statement and carries that statement's period.

| Records of one Ridgeline Consumer Credit statement | Late fee for that statement period |
|---|---|
| payments credited from the statement date through the due date total less than its minimum payment due | one late fee is owed, referencing that statement and carrying its period |
| those payments total the minimum payment due or more | the condition of this rule does not arise |

The late fee line names the statement whose minimum went unpaid and that statement's period, so the account shows one late fee for that period.

## Capability

`post_missed_payment_late_fee_0b17ca39` posts the late fee owed on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account for a statement whose minimum payment was not covered by its due date. It adds one late-fee line to the account ledger, dated today, that references the statement it arises from and carries that statement's period, and raises the amount the cardholder owes by the fee. The cardholder sees the fee on the account right away and on the next statement.

## How it is invoked

The tool belongs to the agent: unlock `post_missed_payment_late_fee_0b17ca39`, then call it with the parameters below.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the reference number of the consumer credit account the fee is charged to, as the account lookup returns it for the verified customer |
| `original_transaction_id` | the reference number of the statement line whose minimum went unpaid, as the account ledger lookup returns it |
| `statement_period` | the statement period of that statement, written YYYY-MM exactly as it appears on the statement line |
| `amount` | the fee amount in USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; it is booked exactly as given |

## Return

A receipt with: `status` — the word posted when the fee line was written; `card_transaction_id` — the reference number of the new fee line; `card_account_id` — the account charged; `fee_type` — `late_fee`; `statement_period` — the period recorded, YYYY-MM; `amount` — the fee in USD with 2 decimals; `transaction_date` — the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD; `current_balance` — the amount owed once the fee is booked, USD with 2 decimals.
